meta_title: B45 Garden + Home Services | Gardeners Birmingham
meta_description: B45 Garden + Home Services in Birmingham offers professional garden design, maintenance, and landscaping. Local, reliable gardeners serving Rubery and surrounding areas.
hero_eyebrow: Local Birmingham Gardeners — Design to Maintenance
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to bespoke landscaping, we design and maintain gardens that add real value to your Birmingham home.
services_subhead: Whether you need a tidy-up or a full garden redesign, we handle everything from planting and pruning to hard landscaping and seasonal care.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: We create bespoke gardens tailored to your space and budget. From patio laying to raised beds and water features, we turn your ideas into reality.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly visits keep your garden looking pristine. Hedging, grass cutting, weeding, and seasonal planting included.

services.title: Lawn Care & Seeding
services.desc: Patchy grass or bare patches? We scarify, aerate, feed, and reseed to restore your lawn. Results visible within weeks.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Work
services.desc: Professional pruning, shaping, and removal. We keep trees and hedges healthy, safe, and looking their best year-round.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Overgrown gardens cleared quickly and responsibly. We remove debris, compost plant waste, and leave your space ready for a fresh start.

services.title: Seasonal Planting & Aftercare
services.desc: Spring bedding, summer colour, autumn interest, and winter structure. We source quality plants and ensure they thrive in your garden.

about_pullquote: A proper garden isn't a luxury—it's the best investment you can make in your home.
about_para_1: B45 Garden + Home Services was founded on the belief that every garden has potential. Over eight years, we've transformed over 500 gardens across Birmingham—from small urban courtyards to sprawling country plots. Our team combines passion for plants with practical know-how, and we're not afraid to get our hands dirty.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation one garden at a time. Our customers return to us because we listen, deliver on our promises, and take genuine pride in our work. Whether you need a one-off tidy or year-round care, we treat your garden like it's our own.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant. Our garden was a complete mess when we moved in—overgrown borders, dead lawn, the lot. The team came in, cleared it all, laid a new patio, and planted it beautifully. Two months on and it's thriving. Best decision we made. Really reasonable price too.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: I've had B45 do my garden maintenance every fortnight for two years now. They're always on time, professional, and they notice things I don't—like when a shrub's struggling. The garden looks immaculate. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Michael D.

reviews.text: Had them out for a quote on hedge trimming and a general tidy-up. No pressure, no nonsense—just a fair price and brilliant work. They came back two weeks later and the whole garden looked transformed. Will definitely be using them again.
reviews.author: Sarah W.
